model.score_convention: Ultralytics detector confidence; not a calibrated image-level PASS probability; reassigned ID0 retains original detector score, not a calibrated ID0 probability
model.preprocessing: uint8 BGR -> Ultralytics aspect-preserving letterbox imgsz=640; original-pixel xyxy output; no EXIF transform on incoming frames
model.rejection: Only learned non_catalogue detection; complete open-set rejection not validated

calibration.model_selection_rule: Leave-one-photo-out 10mm interval RMS; retain global unless correction improves >=20%
calibration.uncertainty_scope: Ruler interval/image-position consistency only; repeated overlapping intervals are not independent samples. No caliper MAE or height-parallax bound.
calibration.supported_input: Original fixed-collection 3024x4032 pixels; geometry runs on original-frame ROIs, not letterboxed network input
calibration.camo_transform: NOT_CONFIRMED: photo EXIF has 1.57mm ultrawide + digital zoom 2.5802; do not infer Camo field of view from resolution
calibration.height_difference: Ruler surface/part measurement planes may differ; distance and specimen heights are not recorded, so no invented parallax correction

initialization.source: Official Ultralytics COCO-pretrained YOLO11n; same initialization SHA as historical P06 trainer

model.size_verification: Measured original pixels + empirical same-specimen development bands; provisional millimetres
model.measurement_strategy: Stage2 exterior-supported screw cross-sections; target-owned nut/annulus contours; quality-gated size rejection
model.foreground: P06 threshold + illumination correction + measured-shape foreground conservation
model.size_bands: Unchanged frozen v1 numerical ranges; no widening or new fit
model.count_decision_score: none: decision derived from observed vs expected counts; object scores unchanged
model.offline_timing: perf_counter: adapter preprocess/features/classifier/postprocess/result validation + GPU completion sync; excludes image decoding, weight load and export; not live latency
